params.name: types
params.description: An array of up to 20 strings (separated by commas) specifying the types of events to return in the response. Can also be queried as `type` in singular form if so desired.

items.docs:
Streams all of an API key's events as they occur using [Server-Sent Events (SSE)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Server-sent_events).

We strongly recommend subscribing to the SSE stream of event data by providing the `Accept: text/event-stream` header with your request.
